beats.caption: United's Bruno Fernandes. Player of the year. Then benched.

beats.say: Como, four-one. Then, on TV, the captain said: it's a decision from the staff to not press man-to-man.
beats.caption: Como 4-1. Then, on TV, the captain said: "It's a decision from the staff to not press man-to-man."

card.sub: Champions League · Fernandes after the defeat, on TV

beats.say: Four days later, Carrick benched him. United lost three-nil to Bournemouth. Fernandes never came on.
beats.caption: 4 days later, Carrick benched him. United lost 3-0 to Bournemouth. Fernandes never came on.

card.sub: Carrick: a "pure football" decision · unused substitute

beats.say: Was Carrick right to bench his captain? Comment below.
beats.caption: Was Carrick right to bench his captain? Comment below.

card.sub: Fernandes: PFA + FWA Player of the Year last season

beats.say: The twist? Bruno agreed. Everyone thought that was a punishment. If it was, it was right.
beats.caption: The twist? Bruno agreed. "Everyone thought that was a punishment… If it was, it was right."

card.kicker: ON THE RECORD · AFTER MAN UTD 3-2 ROMA
card.text:
EVERYONE THOUGHT THAT

beats.say: November twelfth, Carrick was sacked. Bruno's still captain, and contract talks can wait. If I wanted more money, I wouldn't be here.
beats.caption: 12 November, Carrick was sacked. Bruno's still captain, and contract talks can wait: "If I wanted more money, I wouldn't be here."
